title: Report: GTA 6’s New TV Trailer Is A Bit Different, See It For Yourself
description: Gamespot details new GTA 6 TV commercial variations, including removed shower scenes, extended airplane shots, Xbox logo removal, and real-life restaurant tie-ins ahead of launch.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 TV Trailer Cuts Showers Removes Xbox Logo
socialHook: GTA 6's new TV spot cuts shower scenes and removes Xbox logo for Sony promotion.

sections.heading: Trailer Variations
paragraphs: Gamespot's report details how the new GTA 6 TV commercial spots feature subtle but notable changes from the game's launch trailer. A 30-second edit omits the shower scenes with Jason and Lucia, while replacing them with slightly longer airplane sequences and a shot of the duo standing by their car.

sections.heading: Marketing and Release Notes
paragraphs: The article notes that a 90-second version restores the shower scenes alongside the extended sequences, and highlights that Xbox branding was reportedly removed due to Rockstar's promotional deal with Sony. Gamespot also mentions that GTA 6 launch date November 19 is advertised for both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S despite TV spots not displaying the consoles, and that real-life Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell restaurants are selling GTA-branded food as part of the marketing push.
